stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: SID 9000001 explicitly detects TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.0/24) to DB zones (10.1.200.0/24, 10.3.200.0/24) on database ports {5432,3306,1433,27017}. Observed flow 10.1.100.10 → 10.1.200.10:5432 matches this signature exactly.

Per the policy matrix, WEB → DB-OLTP is explicitly DENY. The legitimate application chain is WEB → APP-GW → APP-CORE → DB-OLTP. Direct WEB-to-DB bypasses multiple security layers and violates zero-trust segmentation.

Baseline traffic patterns show no legitimate web-to-database flows. The only expected outbound from web-01 is to APP-GW (10.3.100.10:8080). This flow is NOT in baselines - it is anomalous by definition.

Source host web-01 has a concerning history: 15 total alerts in 30 days, 12 enforced, trust score 0.36. Top SIDs include 9000001 (5x), 9000003 (4x), 9000002 (2x) - all lateral movement/policy violations. This is a repeat offender.

Past incidents with exact SID 9000001: 5/5 were enforced with DROP, confidence 0.95. Semantic similarity search shows consistent enforcement pattern. This is a known threat pattern, not a novel edge case.

Multi-alert correlation shows recent SID sequence: 9000003 (WEB to MGT), 9000040 (ICMP sweep), 9000002 (WEB to APP-CORE direct). This indicates a multi-stage kill chain - reconnaissance followed by lateral movement attempts.
MITRE mapping confirms TA0008 (Lateral Movement) / T1021 (Remote Services). This is textbook lateral movement from an Internet-exposed tier toward the crown-jewel data tier.
Targeted block (src+dst+port) preserves legitimate web-to-appgw-proxy flows while stopping the violation. Blast radius is controlled - only the anomalous path is blocked.

hypotheses.name: Lateral movement / microsegmentation bypass
hypotheses.description: Lateral movement / microsegmentation bypass (probability=0.95) — WEB host attempting direct DB access, violating zero-trust architecture. Evidence: SID 9000001 exact match, policy matrix DENY, no baseline entry, 5/5 past enforcement. Counter: None - this is a hard policy violation.

hypotheses.name: Misconfigured application
hypotheses.description: Misconfigured application (probability=0.04) — Developer accidentally configured web-01 to connect directly to DB-OLTP instead of through proper chain. Evidence: Runtime reputation clean (1.00), no destructive SQL content observed. Counter: 15 prior alerts from this host, 12 enforced, trust score 0.36 - pattern suggests compromise not misconfiguration.

hypotheses.name: Legitimate maintenance from wrong host
hypotheses.description: Legitimate maintenance from wrong host (probability=0.01) — DBA running ad-hoc query from web host instead of MGT bastion. Evidence: None - maintenance should originate from MGT zone per policy. Counter: MGT zone has universal access by design; no reason to use WEB host.
